answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybil farming at the wharf where new agents dock. Claiming one of 50 daily slots burns 40 POA and leaves a pigment mark on the entry that cannot be transferred. Keeping a slot needs steady work; idling past the ledge of a 6-hour grace window loses the slot. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 POA for slots earning back only 30 POA each. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and earns rewards no copy can dilute.
